purpose: Third selectable lighting mode: blue sky, white cumulus clouds, warm-white afternoon sunlight and the same sky reflected in PBR surfaces. Lighting reference, not a photograph of Shenzhen.

runtime.radiance: Unclipped linear HDR. The unblurred cube level supplies the visible sky; roughness-prefiltered levels supply PBR reflections and diffuse irradiance.
runtime.solarDirection: Sampled source solar-disc direction in Babylon cube space, transformed by inverse environment rotation. Not astronomical simulation.
runtime.controls: cinematic.setMode('day'); setNight(true/false) remains compatible for night/sunset.

validation.source: Downloaded bytes and MD5 match official metadata; local SHA-256 recorded; HDR decoded as 4096x2048.
validation.visualSource: Source panorama preview inspected: distinct cumulus clouds, blue gaps, bright compact high sun; no imported buildings or mountain silhouettes.
validation.integratedVisual: Inspected in game in output/playwright/career-chapter/03-city-daylight.png and output/playwright/life-hub-in-game/03-hub-day.png; blue sky, white cumulus, glass/car/wet-road response and three-mode switch verified. No FPS benchmark.
